    The whole learned model

    A tree is just nested questions.

    Training tries halfway points and chooses the question that makes the two child groups least mixed. This tiny tree stops after two levels. 

    IF systolic BP ≤ 140:
  RETURN blue toy label
ELSE:
  IF maximum heart rate ≤ 115:
    RETURN blue toy label
  ELSE:
    RETURN red toy label

    Why this cannot triage a real patient

    Real acute cardiac evaluation uses symptoms, history, physical examination, ECG, serial troponin, structured risk pathways, and other findings. The `140` and `115` cuts here were learned from a made-up grid created only to demonstrate rectangular Decision Tree boundaries.
